notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b004:l001: Visual PDF24: separately extracted decorative К joins without a space to ан to form Кан; the indented боло элек continues the same verse. All three raw fragments retained. Forty-day mourning interval is not yet complete, rather than exactly forty days elapsed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l003: Бадыша sovereign; glossary marker retained in source evidence, not spoken as verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l005: ак бейил well-meaning is printed of Abyke here; do not harmonize narrator epithets with later hostile deeds.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l012: Төмөнкү үч кан the three khans below; no unsupported names or geographic location supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l013: Эр өлүшүп men die/are killed, followed by mares slaughtered in the feasting/mediation context; no replacement by heroes gathering.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l018: Visual right-indented журт эле continues this verse; two physical records count once.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l028: Visual wrap joined. топот түш curse perish, not tumble: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/топот/ records тойуң менен топот түш. Bakai curses the feast rather than consenting to it.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l030: Тоюна printed third-person his feast differs from second-person тоюң/оюнуңа nearby; retained, not harmonized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b005:l031: Printed Тозооку interpreted as lengthened тозоку, accursed/wicked, not glutton: primary Yudakhin and1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/тоз/. No raw emendation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l005: Visual right-indented экен – деп,– continues the verse. Quoted imagined gossip is distinguished from narrator assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l008: Visual right-indented кеп айткан completes this verse; reported yesterday retained as epic speech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l013: Тоодайым my mountain-like one, an affectionate epithet for Manas, not a named mountain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l018: жетимим my orphan refers to Semetey without replacing the actual phrase with his name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l022: жыласына калбаймын interpreted sharing the gathering's destruction/curse; deictic reference is somewhat loose in the speech and not silently clarified to a fresh event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l024: эрим in Bakai's speech my hero/man, not my husband; speaker remains Bakai.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l026: Жар-Конуш retained as Zhar-Konush, place not independently located.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0024:b006:l027: кар ыга/карыга to the old man: Bakai speaks of the old man and the camels in third person before resuming first person; retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l001: Аргын кандын Ажыбай Ajybai of Argyn Khan, not converted to a different genealogy; next verses make him Abyke's travelling companion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l009: Narrator explicitly calls the khan чочко swine; retained as narrative insult.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l011: күпчөк is a leather pail here, not a wheel hub: primary Yudakhin and1969/2015 exact epic beer quotation https://el-sozduk.kg/күп/. бозо fermented grain beer, not distilled арак.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l014: чапчак wooden brewing/storage tub; distinct from preceding leather күпчөк.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l015: чачама уу choking poison is a qualified descriptive interpretation from чача choke/cough and the epic poison formula; chemical identity unspecified. Primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чач/ and Manas encyclopedia volume2 poisoning article reproduce this Semetey line.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l021: баабедин divine/saintly Bahauddin invocation; rendered as prayer, not claim he attends the action. Coroson in next verse is the Khorasan saintly invocation associated with vowed sheep.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l023: көк кене gray tick, derogatory image of engorgement retained, not flattering growth.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l028: Кочкорун Kochkor named alongside Kobosh; do not replace with Abyke or take as a ram.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b003:l038: капшыт yurt wall-side storage space; кара арак strong spirits rather than literal black liquid. Following flask is Kalmyk-style leather көөкөр.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l002: Visual right-indented акмакка сунду эле completes one verse; six scoundrels and forty fools retained as separate counted groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l008: кесек ит great/big dog is an abusive address, not a dog collecting horse hide. Literal rump-hide comparison leads into coercive levirate proposal, rendered as character speech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l014: каада бөлүп printed divided customs/usages provisionally retained; not silently repaired to a better-attested different phrase.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l018: бороз III sexually excited/lustful, not agricultural furrow: Yudakhin plus2015 exact Semetey quotation https://el-sozduk.kg/бороз/. This is Zhakyp's accusation, not factual narrator endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l021: жамбы silver ingots, кундуз beaver pelts in tribute/bribe setting; six thousand and one thousand retained without invented weights.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l023: Текечинин Ормомбек provisionally Ormombek of Tekeche; no unsupported modern location or genealogy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l025: Visual right-indented деп, уктум completes this verse. канчык bitch retained as hostile character speech, not softened to lady.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l029: мураапың interpreted as мурапы inheritance here, referring to Manas's widow under the speaker's coercive marriage proposal; not irrigation official or supportive guardian. Yudakhin/1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/МУРАП/ distinguish inheritance from supportive kinsman. Printed raw lengthening retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l033: Drink stones instead of spirits is a curse, not recipe or medical instruction; next line's father's blood retained as extreme abusive speech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0025:b005:l039: Ике variant of нике Islamic marriage rite; no details of the ceremony added. Speech continues on next PDF page.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l001: Refusal to marry triggers threatened dragging and dogs in the character's coercive speech; translated plainly, without eroticization or endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l012: Кырктын башы Кыргылчал is a separate nominal verse after Kobosh's preparations; no silent transfer of the preparations' subject.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l013: Үзүк yurt covering felt; Shuutu's cap is compared to its great breadth. кул servant/bondsman not omitted; Shuutu speaks the following warning to Kyrgylchal.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l019: Аркар аяк and жез билек describe the gifted horse: wild-sheep feet/copper forelegs. Not a second person with copper wrists.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l023: бадана mail/armor, торгой көз lark-eye-shaped rings, not living birds. Primary Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/badana-5/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l024: Printed келеме кериш, кең күрмө interpreted striped cloth for battle, roomy jacket. Yudakhin/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/келеме/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/кериш/ support cloth and combat senses; raw кериш is not silently replaced by usual жака collar formula.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l029: айча бел moon-like/slender waist is a poetic comparison; no anatomical measurement added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b003:l034: Turban as large as a cauldron is source hyperbole, retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b004:l001: жабык баш interior upper felt valance; the dwelling description continues across columns, but preceding iron-fittings verse remains separate.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b004:l002: Six fingerbreadths beaver edging is printed measure, not converted to centimetres.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b004:l009: ала баш mottled/white-marked heads of horses in this context, not a separate named steed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b004:l014: Reviving embers/dead is the speech's benefactor metaphor; not asserted historical resurrection.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b004:l021: Manas's salt signifies sustenance/hospitality and the debt of loyalty. The warning preserves the repeated literal salt imagery, including the crude desecration question.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b004:l030: The male child Manas left behind is Semetey; original descriptive phrase retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0026:b004:l039: Кызырдуу blessed/protected by Khydyr; not an otherwise unexplained personal adjective.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l005: бейжай wild/disordered and бейбак wretched describe Kanykey in Kobosh's hostile command; insults remain attributed speech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l011: Чалым affectionate/possessive form of Chal referring to Kyrgylchal, retained as Chalym, not a newly invented extra messenger.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l019: Visual right-indented кыңкылдап continues the whimpering verse. Mourning performance is explicitly mocked by the narrative context; no new genuine grief asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l023: тул mourning representation/effigy of the deceased, not widow: Akylai sits at its base. The exact construction of the effigy is not added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l024: кайрак resolute/hardened woman in this epithet, not a literal whetstone.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l028: Visual right-indented ит элең completes one verse; repeated forty-from-forty insult retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l032: Ооган Afghan land retained as epic geography, not a historical claim of actual conquest.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l034: Маргалаң Marghalan; the preceding participial phrase is kept on its own English verse rather than swapping the two source verses.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l037: Жет-Кайт retained as Zhet-Kait, not silently identified with an unverified modern town.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l038: White deer driven and made cattle is epic hyperbole, not zoological correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b003:l039: буй кыл- throw into confusion/disorder, rather than necessarily destroy: exact parallel deer/enemy couplet in primary Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?word=буй. Printed жерди places remains, not replaced by жаону enemy from dictionary witness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l001: Омбу epic Omsk name retained; no attempt to harmonize geographical layers into a modern historical chronology.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l004: Visual right-indented ит элең completes this repeated forty-from-forty verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l011: Буламды fine cloth/property, followed by булап plunder, preserves sound-play as far as possible without treating була as a woman's name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l015: канкор is Manas, here slayer of foes, object of Kanykey's lament; literal violent epithet not converted into a different person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l024: Kyrgylchal seizes Akylai's breast; plain non-erotic description retains the source action and does not infer consent from her subsequent marriage answer.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l033: ал уул that son refers contextually to Kobosh, not a claim he is Akylai's biological son. Seven ancestral generations unbelievers is the quoted curse, not narrator religious judgment.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l038: он талаа ten directions literal tear-streaming hyperbole retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0027:b005:l039: Visual right-indented боло элек completes one verse; first-person sovereign expression begins Kanykey's next lament and continues on next page.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l001: Кумпай falcon type: Yudakhin https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=к&alf2=ку&cur_page=21&dic_id=2&page=list_words explicitly gives кумпайдан тууган born of a falcon. Following каз goose and карга crow retained distinctly, not harmonized as one bird.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l003: Төшөгүн his bed printed first time, төшөгүм my bed in repeat; possessive difference retained. Breast/bosom exposure refers to threatened forced marriage, rendered without erotic elaboration.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l011: Туубай туна чөгөйүн birth-curse, not literal drowning or a claim she has borne no child. Yudakhin entry туна in https://kotormo.kg/sites/default/files/2025-02/sozduk_yudahin.pdf gives exact formula. Kanykey's despair is character speech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l015: Зулпукор the named sword Zulpuqor, not any sharp tool. Missing blade motivates search rather than reported attack here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l020: Quail-like and currant-like eyes, separate streams and whip-length tears are source comparisons, retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l027: Ribs splitting and heart torn are grief images, not new physical wounds.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l032: катын алып тунгудай their taking a wife to enjoy ease; not Kanykey taking another wife.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l034: аш memorial feast here; forty-day mourning remains incomplete. No assertion of a universal modern funeral rule.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l036: кара mourning cloth upon the head; grief black has not yet been removed. Not dark hair falling out.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l001: Printed forehead-bone curve retained as physical image linked to fate; no modern medical explanation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l004: Төбө чачым чогуу эле hair at crown still together, literal unusual line retained without substituting usual sorrow phrase.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l007: Deep dug pit and overwhelming sorrow retain the interlocking grave/misfortune metaphor.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l014: Cradled/lulled child in her lap; young heir cannot yet tend horses, no invented exact age.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l021: Right-indented ит элең visually continues one verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l027: көкбөрү carcass-dragging riding game comparison; no invented account of a current game or a separate Kokboru character.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l032: канга кирип катыктың provisionally bloodshed-hardened in the warrior sequence; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/катык/ gives blood-sated strengthening as an epic motif. Printed кирип retained, not replaced by dictionary ичип/toюп.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l035: шай III unseen protector of heroes, origin Shaymerden; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/шай/ explicitly glosses шай колдогон. Not tea, silk or ordinary strength.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l037: Көзү жок sightless/eyeless, hostile metaphor retained; no claim of a medically established blindness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l005: Kanykey's speech attributes breast-touching to herself although prior narrative showed Akylai. Preserve the printed first person, do not silently harmonize victims or add an unseen incident.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l009: кат written protective/sacred charm tied in belt; curse invokes its power and the God-sworn oath. Exact contents not invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l013: Printed төрөмдү accusative alongside dislocated lament syntax; my falcon-born prince retained without inserting a new action against him.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l023: Door-broad teeth breaking like millet is grotesque epic hyperbole, not regular human dentistry. Source Kyrgyz parallels Manas815/1497/1561/1620/1643/1652 explicitly scatter/grind teeth like millet; Semetey printed бөлүнүп retained in sense break apart, not substituted by быркырап.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l026: Kanykey's intended retaliation against Kyrgylchal, not already completed killing: subsequent action wounds him and he escapes.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l034: Printed Эч мүчөлүү provisionally read as minimally corrupted Эр мүчөлүү, supported by same-page block3 line18 Эр мүчөлүү directly describing Kanykey. No raw alteration. шуркуя here daring/desperate woman, primary Yudakhin sense2 https://el-sozduk.kg/шуркуя/, not automatic sexual accusation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l035: эпчи women's side of the yurt, not simply kitchen or east compass direction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b003:l036: Six heavenly sharp blades all missing; do not insert usual names or make the following Ak-Tinte one of them.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b004:l002: Актинте named knife Ak-Tinte; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/акти/ cross-refers Ак тинте. Price six calves/four yearlings retained, consistent earlier Kyrgyz Manas1768. Not gun.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b004:l020: Printed six scoundrels fleeing/being fled among is grammatically rough; provisionally the two messengers flee in among six, not claim all six previously entered palace unseen.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b004:l024: Strike falls short of kidney and cuts half of millstone-broad rump; graphic literary injury retained without additional anatomical or procedural detail.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b004:l031: Conditional appeal God/Bahauddin/deceased hero spirit, not assertion of divine intervention already achieved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0029:b004:l038: Ак the True/Pure One, divine address in prayer; no white horse inserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l003: Right shoulder-blade lower region and two ribs cut, as printed; previous rump wound is Kyrgylchal's, this blow lands on Tazbaimat fleeing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l010: Суркызыл and Кертелки are named horses Surkyzyl/Kertelki; source does not assign each rider here, so no unsupported mapping added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l012: анттар accursed/oath-breakers in context, not wounded abstract oaths.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l016: Visual indented журт бузган completes one verse; same printed каада бөлүп divided customs qualified as on25.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l019: Visual indented журт бузган completes one verse; repeated hostile accusation kept, not narrator endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l024: бели secure backing/support metaphor, not recovery of the wounded man's actual waist.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l029: Ormombek of Tekeche retained as in25, without independent geographical identification.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b003:l035: быйыл this year printed; no substitution of today to match nearer threats.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l003: Visual right-indented Тазбаймат completes one verse; both reporting messengers preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l008: Printed Төрөнун legacy-normalized typo left raw; prince's wife Kanykey is the object of their intended humiliation, not speaker endorsing it.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l015: Semetey is object of threatened violence; plural oath-makers remain subject of Убаданы бек кылды despite name immediately preceding. It does not say the cradle infant swears an oath.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l017: балтыр бешик nursing/cradle infancy, no invented exact months. Threat to drag infant to dogs is existing literary villain speech, without elaboration.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l022: Жыртык кара үй torn black yurt and Жырык кара уй damaged/maimed black cow are different printed nouns; retain both rather than copying yurt twice as other witnesses do.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l024: Алкымдагы provisionally nearby/below cattle herdsman; no invented named estate or anatomical throat scene.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l028: кер байтал bay mare and кементай felt cloak denote reduced status; neither color nor garment silently updated to another witness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l032: Cut soles and salt is threatened torture in literary plot, translated without added technique or endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l035: тындым кылуу kill/destroy, Yudakhin exact entry in https://kotormo.kg/sites/default/files/2025-02/sozduk_yudahin.pdf, not merely silence by persuasion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0030:b004:l036: Chewing white wheat flour and holding Quran are oath rites. Primary Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/келеме/ explains келеме шарып; do not translate келеме here as cloth from26.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b003:l003: Six names explicitly cumulative: Abyke/Kobosh two, Chyibyt/Kochkor four, Adybai/Kolbai six. Preserve this witness's roster, not a substituted standard list.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b003:l006: Pale mottled pennant/banner is printed; two who go as khans most naturally Abyke/Kobosh, but text not expanded to pretend explicit naming in that verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b003:l015: шамыян yoke-pin, primary1969/2015 exact Шамыянын шайлатып quotation https://el-sozduk.kg/шам/; not pavilion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b003:l019: чалгырт malice/hidden ill intent in eyes, primary Yudakhin exact formula https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=ч&alf2=ча&cur_page=13&dic_id=2&page=list_words. Not squinting diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b003:l028: арачы mediator refers to attacked messengers; no new arbitrator invented. Speaker shifts to first-person complaint within collective six-scoundrel speech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b003:l036: камчыга ченеп divide by measure of whip, a violent seizure formula retained literally, no invented fair allocation method.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l001: кээсин чыгаруу exact revenge idiom as earlier Manas1780:11, no demon exorcism; primary https://el-sozduk.kg/кээ/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l006: Sword-sheath image retained literally as threatened reduction/violence; exact implication uncertain, no added sexual mechanism.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l007: Printed күнгө сын provisionally spectacle before sun/daylight alongside калайыкка сын later. Does not silently emend күн day to күң slavewoman. Full idiomatic force uncertain; literal wording disclosed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l015: As though Alooke's Kongurbai and Chinese enemy had come: explicit comparison, not actual arrival of Kongurbai.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l020: бардыгер all/everything available, not a proper name or divine force. Primary Yudakhin https://eurasica.ru/dict/?l=b&w=764 and2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/bardyger-2/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l027: Ыраман кандын Ырчыуул Yrchyuul son of Yraman Khan, named warrior/bard; no replacement with a modern poet or generic singer.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l034: Көк-Жайык Kok-Zhaiyk place retained, not independently fixed to a modern map.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l036: урдуу radiant/noble epithet of Kanykey among Muslims; not Urdu language or foreign ethnicity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0031:b004:l039: Жылгындуунун ою hollow/valley of Zhylgynduu, retained place name without unsupported exact location.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b003:l006: Marten-fur caps made in pairs: кош-коштон literal pairing retained; possible doubled skins/layers not asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b003:l008: бил rule/govern in context of appointing companions; world dominion is epic rhetoric, not historical assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b003:l013: Printed жаз билек provisionally жез билек copper forelegs, supported by same horse formula PDF26. Raw spelling retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b003:l019: келеме outer cloth garment as PDF26, not Quran here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b003:l021: Companion without a people is assigned Argyn to govern; not an anonymous dead man.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b004:l005: Printed Сандыргалуу provisionally санжыргалуу illustrious/authoritative. Yudakhin exact санжыргалуу кан https://el-sozduk.kg/санжырга/. No raw emendation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b004:l016: Printed бирге provisionally пирге saints in established он эки пирге кол берген formula: primary Kyrgyz Karalaev https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Manas-eposu-1-tom.pdf. Raw retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0032:b004:l027: Чалыяр variant чарыяр, four first caliphs/Companions: primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чалыяр/ and /чарыяр/. Not mausoleum sense in this context.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0033:b003:l002: бадыраң темир common iron, not cucumber; Yudakhin entry in https://kotormo.kg/sites/default/files/2025-02/sozduk_yudahin.pdf.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0033:b003:l007: Кадыр түн Night of Power, not an ordinary comfortable night.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0033:b003:l025: Күн Жаң-жуң epic general Kun Zhang-Zhung; Kyrgyz Manas2010 PDF296/329/345 also distinguish paired Ай and Күн generals. Conditional enemy comparison retained, no actual Chinese descent asserted of Kanykey.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0033:b005:l004: Билге elephant, not бел waist; tribute loaded on elephants.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0033:b005:l006: Камбыл place Kambyl, paired Кара-Шаар elsewhere in same Kyrgyz Semetey source PDF650/674; not adjective ready/wise.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0033:b005:l026: адырмак rolling hills, not invented Adyrmak proper name: Yudakhin/1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/адырмак/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0034:b003:l021: Black donkey transformation is character warning about punishment in other world; literal retained without asserting belief as fact.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0034:b003:l027: Туу казына lasting treasure epithet for infant; primary Seytek quotation in government publication https://mamtil.gov.kg/storage/post/file/b1c77b42b47490ad101a5226cbe26373666f559f.pdf. Not horse breed туу казанат.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0034:b003:l030: Mountain advancing is printed rhetorical question; do not silently replace тоо mountain with жоо enemy, which next couplet explicitly supplies.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0034:b004:l020: багалак knucklebone game here; pelts are stakes. Yudakhin and Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/багалак/ distinguish garment-ankle sense from абалак/game; Kyrgyz Manas camp passage explicitly pairs same divided pelts with game.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0034:b004:l021: Slave whose master died struts without restraint, not a bereaved slave mourning.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0034:b004:l029: орокто rider bobbing/dipping movement, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/орокто/. Он башы commander of ten; not reaping heads.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0034:b004:l037: куяш provisionally sun in eclipse context (Turkic literary term), rather than2015 dialect east. Kyrgyz author Kalyk Ibraimov uses куяш-күн in https://ruhesh.kg/ky/category/show/news/1202/kalik-ibraimov-aysha-kel-2. Eclipse is narrative portent, no dated astronomical event asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b003:l001: Yrchyuul fleeing to his fathers city continues preceding page; not Kanykey yet escaping.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b003:l009: Naked child beside/on shoulder of Kanykey speaks a supernatural warning; original child retained, no invented messenger or age.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b003:l011: көнчөк earlobe, appropriate child upon shoulder whispering into ear; primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/көнчөк/. Not trouser leg.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b003:l019: Ak-Tinte price repeated six calves/four yearlings as PDF29; retain repetition.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b003:l027: Kanykeys thought of slaughtering sixty mourning women is unexecuted violent intent, not already committed action.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b003:l032: дүйнө бок literally shitty/dung world; grief profanity retained, not cleaned up as merely cruel world.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b005:l009: Teeth door-broad breaking like millet repeats rage hyperbole, as PDF29; no modern anatomical correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b005:l013: Indented Кокондон completes one verse; Six Cities/Kokand epic geography left as printed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b005:l021: туймуйган provisionally quiet/demure junior wife, precise expressive nuance uncertain; senior/junior marital rank retained without endorsing hierarchy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b005:l024: Алты кер six bay horses laden with goods, not six yurt walls; wealth/marriage price sequence.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b005:l031: Ат көтү horse rump provisionally carried behind saddle in bridal capture/removal context; no additional sexual act invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0035:b005:l035: бел support/backing in remarriage accusation; retain ambiguity rather than invent explicit sexual anatomy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b003:l004: Repeated бел support/backing wordplay in coercive remarriage accusation, not literal waist-binding command.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b003:l024: дүрбү telescope/spyglass treasured belonging of Manas; source anachronistic object retained, not modern binoculars or invented sword.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b003:l028: белдемчи womans wraparound overskirt, fold used to secure telescope; not ammunition belt.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b003:l030: Smelling the keepsake retains sensory grief action and repeated packing, not compressed as simple remembrance.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b003:l039: Chyiyrdy is Kanykeys mother-in-law and Manass mother; source эне mother address retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b004:l012: Туу казанат genuine/splendid steed, human epithet, distinct preceding туу казына treasure PDF34. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/казанат/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b004:l026: Threatened infant killing is feared future, not completed action; repeated бейм uncertainty retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0036:b004:l032: тунжур female goshawk, metaphor of male infant remains sex-mismatched as printed: primary Yudakhin/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/тунжур/. It is not the adjective pensive.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l007: даңгыт mature male dogs here, not Tangut ethnicity:1969 exact road-dragging formula https://el-sozduk.kg/даңгыт/. Literary threat only, no added technique.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l008: казгалдак wild duck type: Yudakhin/1969 exact Semetey couplet https://el-sozduk.kg/казгалдак/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l019: байыдык decline/ebb in lament after losing son, not modern wealth enrichment despite homographic байы become rich.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l023: калмышында finally: Yudakhin/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/калмыш/. жеп алдык literally devoured your son, grief self-blame rather than invented literal cannibalism scene.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l025: Printed кымыз ичпес would not drink kumys retained, rather than harmonized to an expected accustomed-to-kumys reading; ensuing poverty brackish water remains.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l031: коргончо small walled enclosure of sons tomb in Ak-Chiy/main road sequence, not newly invented military fort.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l035: Үйрүлмө Uyurulmo place retained, not independently located.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b003:l038: моло таш rounded/boulder-like stone infant epithet, not gravestone or diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b004:l003: өлгөндө көргөн acquired at deaths door/after great hardship idiom, not child literally born after grandmothers death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b004:l020: Будурмак treated as named landscape here: Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/будурмак/ locates same escape passage, distinct ordinary адырмак rolling hills on38.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0037:b004:l031: кумпай falcon as established primary dictionary PDF28; grandmother boasts protective power, no narrator guarantee.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b003:l013: Six scoundrels former deference occurred during Manass lifetime; Kanykey rebuts Chyiyrdys claimed present protection.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b003:l020: сында жок beyond compare/description, not no sign: primary Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/сын/. Conceded strength does not restore absent Manas.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b003:l021: Printed бирге provisionally пирге twelve saints as32; raw unchanged.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b003:l028: Chyiyrdy eighty explicitly printed; retain age without chronological harmonization.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b003:l039: багалчак ankle-region flesh, distinct багалак knucklebone game34.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b004:l002: кабак bank/overhang shelter, not eyebrow or pumpkin.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b004:l007: Almighty determines death in narratorial lament, not medical impossibility claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b004:l016: Chatkal, Buuras Pass, Kyrchyndy and Kaiypchys Black Cave retained as epic landscape; no modern coordinates added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0038:b004:l037: кайрылып turns/flys rather than previous кайрылбай without turning; preserve witnesses actual variation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b003:l003: кемирчек edible-root thistle plant here, not cartilage: Yudakhin/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/кемирчек/. Gnawing wild plant conveys famine.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b003:l014: ыйман deathbed profession of faith, not absence of moral virtue.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b003:l022: Marghalan appears in projected wandering lament, no claim narrative already physically moves there.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b003:l034: Жебирейил Gabriel explicitly named soul-taker; do not correct theology to Azrael. Literary plea for death translated without added advice.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b003:l035: беш кол five fingers idiom, not five independent hands.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b004:l005: Ribs coming apart grief/exhaustion hyperbole retained, not a new medical diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b004:l011: ак шамшар bright blade, subsequent бычак knife preserved without forcing two different objects. Striped neck literal decorative description uncertain exact fitting.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b004:l016: Infant grabs knife and reaches for grandmother; existing literary interruption of intended self-harm, no added method.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b004:l019: сында жок beyond description as38, here distress rather than flattering perfection.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b004:l038: сында жок beyond compare, primary1969 exact улуктугуң сында жок https://el-sozduk.kg/сын/. Former status explicitly during Manass lifetime.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0039:b004:l036: огой = ногой with initial n elision, explicitly documented Manas2010 editorial PDF15:b002:l005; exact Kara kylar Ogoy jok parallel PDF184:b002:l044. Translate Nogai support, no emendation to өгөй step-relative and no invented individual guardian.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b003:l006: упа variant опаа faithfulness/fidelity, not cosmetic powder: primaryYudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/упа/ gives exact world formula.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b003:l012: Narrators leave-this-and-turn-to-another-thread verses retained as part of oral poem, not omitted as editorial prose.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b003:l017: Kanykey age32 explicitly printed, not reconciled with other chronologies.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b003:l023: Кара күң Kara Kung, literally Black/dark slavewoman, is character designation; first occurrence translated descriptor as well as name in final review. No inference of modern racial identity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b003:l027: болжош guiding mark/sign, primaryYudakhin exactstar metaphor https://el-sozduk.kg/болжош/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b004:l001: Plane tree figurative departed Manas in appeal to honor him, literal image retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b004:l005: Жети аркар Seven Wild Sheep stars, printed asterism retained without uncertain modern constellation mapping.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b004:l006: Seven circuits/turns nursing retained; milk kinship/adoption context, not literal sevenmonths.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b004:l011: Same birth date; raised as twins despite different mothers, no fabricated biological twin claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b004:l015: Russians and Chinese attended birth feast in remembered epic narrative, not verified historical event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b004:l026: Sudden if-I-die first-person may quote Manass past concern or Kanykeys present fear; tentative embedded quotation retained and following protective vow not smoothed into new explicit speaker.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0040:b004:l035: асый чыкма approaching full-grown livestock; тай/тайлак young horse/camel paired formula, exact ages not invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b003:l001: Жообузар Zhoobuzar named child, not silently replaced with later names or general enemy-destroyer.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b003:l007: Narrator curse/devil possession epithet retained, not medical psychiatric diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b003:l021: кеөнүм ток ironic indifference to own child immediately challenged; Kara Kung refuses child transfer, no inference consent.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b003:l039: өлбөй кал counterfactual lament if only you had not died, not resurrection order.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b005:l014: Existing literary killing described only to source detail; lower rib/lung-side wording retained without tactical elaboration.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b005:l021: Printed Кара күндү loss of ң understood same Kara Kung in continuous scene, raw retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b005:l024: тундурма buried/concealed with surface restored, primaryYudakhin exact hearth/bent-body formula https://el-sozduk.kg/тундурма/. Not infusion/drink; English limits description to buried out of sight.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b005:l026: баргек golden forehead/hair ornament supporting childs head; primaryYudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/баргек/. Not dried apricots or earlier metaphor for cherished gun.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b005:l027: чылк дилде pure gold coins/literal lavish wrapping, no rationalizing into plaincloth.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b005:l028: Right-breast nursing establishes foster relation, no erotic framing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0041:b005:l039: Кара кан Kara Khan printed distinct from Темир кан Temir Khan three verses earlier; retained without unproved harmonization.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b003:l004: касаба standard/banner, not snowdrift: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/касаба/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b003:l021: Four origins Altai/Khangai/China/Crimea all retained as oral parenthesis, not discarded as prose.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b003:l025: Printed далбакка provisionally далбаага falconry lure, primaryYudakhin exact карчыга үндөп далбаага https://el-sozduk.kg/далба/. Raw unchanged; not interpreted clumsy bird for this dative command.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b003:l036: жеке broad leather battle belt, primaryYudakhin exact waist-girding formula https://el-sozduk.kg/жеке/. Next repeated жеке means alone, preserving wordplay; not boots or sword.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b004:l002: Baichoro and Manas sons of brothers, cousins explicitly; not biological brothers.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b004:l007: Baichoro does not know Abyke/Kobosh turned enemy; thinks Beijing invasion. Distinguish mistaken belief from narratorfact.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b004:l016: Faster than arrow hyperbole and sequential blows retained; noaddedinjury.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0042:b004:l033: Horse Telkyzyl stumbles, leading to capture; do not change to Surkyzyl from nextpagespeech.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b003:l022: аадан = наадан fool/ignorant with initial n elision, Manas2010 editorial PDF15:b002:l006 explicitly listsvariant. Baichoros bitter self-reproach, not translatorjudgment.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b003:l023: Six lions youngest refers Manas in embedded eulogy, no rosterinvented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b003:l027: Surkyzyl printed here although prior narrative Telkyzyl; keep witness inconsistency. токтугу well-fed/full condition, not lackoffood.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b003:l033: айда monthly/monthaftermonth punitive tribute collection, no specificcalendar added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b003:l037: бок shit explicit refusal of even worthless tribute; retain profanity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b005:l010: Жойболот deadly/striking steel per Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/жой/. Alongside pine spear no inferred Bakai sword or Almambet gun ownership; no unsupported metallurgy wrought steel.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b005:l018: Kaldai title/group and Shibe ethnonym retained; noforced modern ethnic equivalence.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b005:l023: уз craftswomen/seamstresses, not ordinary skilled male craftspeople in this bride/plunder sequence.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b005:l024: Ai Zhang-Zhung distinct earlier Kun Zhang-Zhung; daughter Byrmyskal and Burulcha named separately as printed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0043:b005:l038: өлгөндө көргөн hard-won late child, not assertion born after fatherdied; source40said birth feast hostedManas.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b003:l035: Kanykey explicitly says forty days have not passed since Manas died and his memorial feast has not yet been held; self-lament bereavement, with self-abasing shade acknowledged. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0028:b004:l008: Continuation of the widowed Kanykey mourning Manas and predicting hostility from his relatives; not narrator accusation of misconduct. transcription_check.scope: All20 individual page images inspected at1800px, left column then right. Drop-cap and indented continuations grouped manually; exact source raw glyphs and coordinates retained with legacy-font-v1. No manuscript collation.

alignment_check.scope: Every reconstructed source/English position read in paired review files, pages24–31,32–35,36–39,40–43. Final corrections reread. Repeated verses, narrator transitions, parentheses, profanities and inconsistent names retained. Wholly unresolved verses withheld from English and preserved separately.

translation_provenance: Direct model Kyrgyz-to-English translation from exact extraction and page images; no prior published English poem, external MT or MT API used.
